Syncster Historical Market Data
	

Free historical market data from @Syncster_APP: 1-minute stock bars, 1-minute options bars, futures (1m + tick), global indices, VIX, the Fed funds rate and Treasury yields, macro series, short interest/volume, open interest and options flow.
Join the free Discord through growththroughoptions.com.

Not financial advice. For research and education only. Provided as-is, with no guarantee of accuracy or completeness.

Total: 66.90 GB of Parquet… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/syncster-data/historical-market-data.
